reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Sound, matches the pending human fix
summary: The Escape keydown handler now runs for modal dialogs too: with keyboard false it calls preventDefault() and plays the static-backdrop bounce, so the close request never starts; dialogs with the default options keep the native cancel path.
caveats: The bounce is also triggered for a non-modal dialog with keyboard false, which has no backdrop; the pending human fix (#43077) limits it to modal dialogs.
